name: computer_connect
description: Redeem an operator code for a grant and ask for the desktop lease (held or queued).

code.description: The tc- code the operator minted.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_status
description: Lease state, queue position, grant TTL, driver version, telemetry state.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_release
description: Give up the lease for the next grant.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_disconnect
description: End the session and drop the grant binding.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_grants
description: Show this session's grant (app, tools, expiry); never other grants.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_apps
description: Running pids of the granted app only.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_windows
description: Windows of the granted app only.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_read
description: AX tree of a granted window, menu bar removed, element tokens included; with an invoke_menu grant, also the allowed menu paths.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_verify
description: Check a predicate on window state.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_screenshot
description: Image of the granted window only, when the grant names screenshot_window; no menu bar or AX tree; refused while a password field shows.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_click
description: Click an element by token in background; returns confirmed by read-back.

element_token.description: Token from the last computer_read of this window.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_double_click
description: As computer_click, with a double click.

element_token.description: Token from the last computer_read of this window.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_right_click
description: As computer_click, with the secondary button.

element_token.description: Token from the last computer_read of this window.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_scroll
description: Scroll an element by token.

element_token.description: Token from the last computer_read of this window.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_type
description: Insert up to 2000 chars into an element by token.

element_token.description: Token from the last computer_read of this window.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_set_value
description: Set an AX value on an element by token.

element_token.description: Token from the last computer_read of this window.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_key
description: One key to the granted app; quit, close, hide, switch chords refused.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_hotkey
description: A chord to the granted app; quit, close, hide, switch chords refused.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_launch
description: Background-launch the granted bundle id only.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_invoke_menu
description: Invoke a menu item of the granted app by its label path, when the grant names invoke_menu; activates the target app (brings it to the front); the path must be one computer_read listed as menu for this window; the Apple and app menus, Quit, Close, Hide Others, Show All, Move to Trash, Print, Export, Save As, Services, Open With, Share and System Settings are never listed. Known limitation: Localized labels outside first two menus (e.g., 'Teilen' for Share in File menu) may not be blocked. First two menu items (Apple, app menu) are refused by position.

path.description: Menu labels from the menu bar down, as computer_read lists them.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_click_at
description: Left click at a window coordinate of the granted window, when the grant names coordinate_input; x and y are window-local with a top-left origin, in the coordinate space of the granted window image; refused unless the point lies inside the window's frame as the broker reads it just before the click.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_drag
description: Currently refused (drag_unavailable_needs_window_on_top_check) until the broker can check the granted window is on top. Left-button drag between two window coordinates of the granted window, when the grant names coordinate_input; activates the target app for the drag (brings it to the front, then restores the prior app); both points are window-local with a top-left origin, in the coordinate space of the granted window image; refused unless both lie inside the window's frame as the broker reads it just before the drag.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_focus
description: Bring the granted window to the front, when the grant names window_management; activates the target app (takes the foreground from the user's current app). Refused unless window_id is the granted window and the daemon lists it under the granted pid at call time; no other window, app or the desktop is touched.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_move_window
description: Move the granted window so its top-left corner is at x, y in desktop points (the space computer_windows reports), keeping its size, when the grant names window_management. Refused unless window_id is the granted window and the daemon lists it under the granted pid at call time; no other window, app or the desktop is touched.

x.description: Desktop X of the window's top-left corner.

y.description: Desktop Y of the window's top-left corner.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_resize_window
description: Resize the granted window to width x height desktop points, keeping its top-left corner, when the grant names window_management. Refused unless window_id is the granted window and the daemon lists it under the granted pid at call time; no other window, app or the desktop is touched.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_wait
description: Sleep up to 5 s in the broker; keeps the lease alive.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.

name: computer_refresh
description: Re-list pids and rescope after a relaunch or new window.

request_id.description: Idempotency key; a uuid4 is filled when omitted.
